subject.title: Feishu: benign non-zero exec exit codes render as "Exec failed" in tool-progress and interrupt streaming; no per-channel toolProgress toggle

question: Should Feishu adopt the shared nested streaming preview policy for `streaming.preview.toolProgress` and `streaming.preview.commandText`, and should `channels.feishu.streaming` remain protected from agent `config.patch` writes?
rationale: The source issue is clear, but the durable fix changes Feishu's public config shape and touches the model-to-operator config mutation boundary.

options.title: Adopt shared Feishu preview policy
options.body: Extend Feishu to accept the shared nested streaming preview config while preserving boolean defaults, and leave `config.patch` protection unchanged unless separately approved.

options.title: Only adjust exec/progress wording
options.body: Keep Feishu boolean-only and reduce scary progress text, which is smaller but leaves no supported way to stream answers while hiding progress lines.

options.title: Allow coarse gateway toggle
options.body: Add `channels.feishu.streaming` to the gateway mutation allowlist, which helps recovery but broadens an operator-controlled config path and does not provide status-only progress.

recommendation.title: Adopt shared Feishu preview policy
recommendation.body: Extend Feishu to accept the shared nested streaming preview config while preserving boolean defaults, and leave `config.patch` protection unchanged unless separately approved.

likelyOwner.reason: The Feishu plugin metadata names this handle as the community maintenance signal for Feishu-owned policy decisions.
